example: We had to abandon the picnic because of the storm.
example_translation: 由于暴风雨，我们不得不放弃野餐。
note: 可接计划、活动或人；本例为放弃活动

example: Her ability to explain difficult ideas helped the whole class.
example_translation: 她解释难懂概念的能力帮助了全班同学。

example: With a little help, he was able to repair the bicycle.
example_translation: 在一点帮助下，他修好了自行车。

example: The machine stopped when it detected an abnormal temperature.
example_translation: 机器检测到异常温度时停止了运转。
note: 不将不常见直接等同有问题

meaning: 在船、飞机或列车上；上船等
example: The train was about to leave, so we hurried aboard.
example_translation: 火车快开了，我们赶紧上了车。
note: 本例为副词，无后接宾语

example: We made a short film about life in our village.
example_translation: 我们拍了一部关于村庄生活的短片。

example: A small lamp hung above the kitchen table.
example_translation: 厨房餐桌上方挂着一盏小灯。
note: above 不必表示垂直正上方

example: She hopes to study abroad after finishing school.
example_translation: 她希望毕业后到国外学习。

example: His absence from the meeting surprised us.
example_translation: 他缺席会议让我们感到意外。

example: Two students were absent from class this morning.
example_translation: 今天上午有两名学生缺课。

example: The guide was absolutely certain that we had taken the wrong path.
example_translation: 向导十分确定我们走错了路。

example: Dry soil can absorb a surprising amount of water.
example_translation: 干燥的土壤能吸收相当多的水。

example: The teacher used pictures to explain an abstract idea.
example_translation: 老师用图片解释一个抽象概念。
note: 形容词重音在首音节；动词读音另审

example: The abuse of public money must be investigated.
example_translation: 必须调查滥用公款的行为。
note: 本批为名词，词尾 /s/；动词词尾 /z/

example: The library offers access to several academic journals.
example_translation: 图书馆提供几种学术期刊的查阅服务。

example: I recognized her voice despite her unfamiliar accent.
example_translation: 尽管她的口音陌生，我还是认出了她的声音。

example: She decided to accept the invitation to speak at the school.
example_translation: 她决定接受到学校演讲的邀请。

meaning: 使用或进入的机会、权利
example: Students have free access to the online archive.
example_translation: 学生可以免费使用这个在线档案库。

example: Nobody was injured in the traffic accident.
example_translation: 这起交通事故中无人受伤。

example: We need to find accommodation near the university.
example_translation: 我们需要在大学附近找住处。

example: A teacher will accompany the students on the museum visit.
example_translation: 一名老师将陪学生参观博物馆。

example: I opened a bank account to save money for the trip.
example_translation: 我开了一个银行账户，为旅行存钱。

example: An accurate map helped us find the hidden entrance.
example_translation: 一张准确的地图帮助我们找到了隐蔽的入口。

example: Do not accuse someone of cheating without evidence.
example_translation: 没有证据，不要指责别人作弊。

example: My shoulders began to ache after carrying the heavy bag.
example_translation: 背过那个沉重的包后，我的肩膀开始疼了。

example: The team worked together to achieve its main goal.
example_translation: 团队共同努力，实现了主要目标。

example: Completing the project was a major achievement for the class.
example_translation: 完成这个项目是全班取得的一项重大成果。

example: The scientist added a small amount of acid to the solution.
example_translation: 科学家向溶液中加入了少量的酸。
note: 本批为名词，不表示酸性的

example: We must acknowledge the limits of our knowledge.
example_translation: 我们必须承认自己知识的局限。

example: Children acquire new skills through play.
example_translation: 孩子们通过游戏学会新技能。

example: A wooden bridge stretches across the stream.
example_translation: 一座木桥横跨小溪。

example: We need to act quickly before the water rises.
example_translation: 我们需要在水位上涨前迅速行动。

example: The council promised immediate action to improve road safety.
example_translation: 地方议会承诺立即采取行动，改善道路安全。

example: She plays an active role in the school gardening club.
example_translation: 她在学校园艺社团中发挥着积极作用。

example: Painting is a popular activity during the holiday camp.
example_translation: 绘画是假期营地里一项受欢迎的活动。

example: The walk looked short on the map, but it was actually quite long.
example_translation: 地图上那段路看起来很短，实际上却相当长。

example: It takes time to adapt to a new learning environment.
example_translation: 适应新的学习环境需要时间。
note: adapt to sth；不与 adopt 混淆

example: We watched a film adaptation of the novel.
example_translation: 我们看了这部小说的电影改编作品。

example: Please add your name to the list before Friday.
example_translation: 请在周五之前把你的名字加到名单上。

example: The clinic offers support to a recovering drug addict.
example_translation: 这家诊所为一名正在康复的吸毒成瘾者提供帮助。
note: 名词首音节重读；不套用动词音标

example: The new reading room is a welcome addition to the school.
example_translation: 新阅览室是学校一项受欢迎的新增设施。

example: Write your full address clearly on the envelope.
example_translation: 在信封上清楚地写下你的完整地址。

example: You can adjust the height of the chair with this handle.
example_translation: 你可以用这个把手调整椅子的高度。

example: She is responsible for the administration of the training programme.
example_translation: 她负责这个培训项目的管理工作。

example: I admire her patience when she teaches young children.
example_translation: 我钦佩她教小孩子时的耐心。

example: He had to admit that his first answer was wrong.
example_translation: 他不得不承认自己的第一个答案是错的。

example: The class voted to adopt a new recycling plan.
example_translation: 全班投票决定采用一项新的回收计划。
note: 本批选采用方案义；不是 adapt

example: Every child must be accompanied by an adult.
example_translation: 每个孩子都必须由一名成年人陪同。

example: The rescue team could not advance through the deep snow.
example_translation: 救援队无法在深雪中前进。

example: Living near the station gives us an advantage when travelling.
example_translation: 住在车站附近让我们出行时占有优势。

example: Their journey across the island became an unforgettable adventure.
example_translation: 他们横穿岛屿的旅程成了一次难忘的冒险经历。

example: Local shops advertise their products in the village newsletter.
example_translation: 当地商店在村里的通讯上宣传自己的产品。

example: Her advice helped me prepare for the interview.
example_translation: 她的建议帮助我准备了面试。

example: Teachers advise students to check their work carefully.
example_translation: 老师建议学生认真检查自己的作业。
note: advise sb to do sth；词尾 /z/

example: The students advocate using less plastic at school.
example_translation: 学生们提倡在学校减少塑料的使用。

example: The missing keys turned a simple visit into a complicated affair.
example_translation: 钥匙丢失使一次简单的拜访变成了一件复杂的事。
note: 本批为事情义，不误配恋情

example: Heavy rain may affect the time of our departure.
example_translation: 大雨可能影响我们的出发时间。

example: We cannot afford to replace all the computers this year.
example_translation: 我们今年无法负担更换全部电脑的费用。

example: The little boy was afraid of the thunder.
example_translation: 那个小男孩害怕雷声。

example: The exhibition includes photographs of wildlife in Africa.
example_translation: 展览中有非洲野生动物的照片。
note: 专有名词，显示保留首字母大写

example: We will discuss the results after lunch.
example_translation: 我们将在午饭后讨论结果。

example: The workshop begins at two in the afternoon.
example_translation: 工作坊在下午两点开始。

example: We visited the castle and had lunch nearby afterward.
example_translation: 我们参观了城堡，之后在附近吃了午饭。
note: afterward 不套用 afterwards 的词尾 /z/

example: Read the final paragraph again before you answer.
example_translation: 回答之前再读一遍最后一段。

example: Several residents spoke against the proposed road.
example_translation: 几位居民发言反对拟建的道路。

example: Children of the same age may learn at different speeds.
example_translation: 年龄相同的孩子可能有不同的学习速度。

example: A travel agency helped us arrange the journey.
example_translation: 一家旅行社帮助我们安排了旅程。

example: The first item on the agenda is the school trip.
example_translation: 议程上的第一项是学校旅行。

example: We moved to this town three years ago.
example_translation: 我们三年前搬到了这个镇上。
note: 通常与一般过去时连用

example: I agree with your suggestion about the meeting time.
example_translation: 我同意你关于会议时间的建议。
note: agree with sb or a suggestion

example: The two schools signed an agreement to share their sports facilities.
example_translation: 两所学校签署了共享体育设施的协议。

example: New technology can make agriculture more efficient.
example_translation: 新技术可以提高农业生产效率。

example: The narrow path continued ahead into the forest.
example_translation: 狭窄的小路向前延伸进森林。

example: The village received emergency aid after the flood.
example_translation: 洪水过后，这个村庄收到了紧急援助。

example: The main aim of the project is to protect the river.
example_translation: 这个项目的主要目标是保护河流。
note: 本批为名词，不混入动词题

example: Open the window to let some fresh air into the room.
example_translation: 打开窗户，让一些新鲜空气进入房间。

example: The airline changed our flight to an earlier time.
example_translation: 航空公司把我们的航班改到了更早的时间。

example: We reached the airport two hours before our flight.
example_translation: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达了机场。

example: The fire alarm rang during the science lesson.
example_translation: 科学课上，火灾警报响了。
note: 本例为报警器发出的警报

example: The label says that the drink contains no alcohol.
example_translation: 标签上写着这种饮料不含酒精。

example: An alert appeared on the screen when the battery was low.
example_translation: 电量不足时，屏幕上出现了一条警示。
note: 本批选可数警示，不作为形容词出题

example: The injured bird was still alive when the volunteers arrived.
example_translation: 志愿者到达时，那只受伤的鸟还活着。

example: All of them returned safely before sunset.
example_translation: 他们所有人都在日落前安全返回了。

example: The museum does not allow visitors to touch the paintings.
example_translation: 博物馆不允许参观者触摸画作。

example: We had almost finished the work when the lights went out.
example_translation: 灯熄灭时，我们几乎已经完成了工作。

example: She was alone in the classroom after everyone else had left.
example_translation: 其他人都离开后，她独自留在教室里。

example: We walked along the river until we reached the bridge.
example_translation: 我们沿河走，直到来到桥边。

example: The smaller boat came alongside, and we passed over the supplies.
example_translation: 较小的船靠了过来，我们把物资递了过去。
note: 本批为副词，不后接宾语

example: Please read the instructions aloud so everyone can hear them.
example_translation: 请出声朗读说明，让每个人都能听到。

example: The shop was already closed when we arrived.
example_translation: 我们到达时，商店已经关门了。

example: The course teaches writing and also includes speaking practice.
example_translation: 这门课教授写作，也包括口语练习。

meaning: 可供选择的事物；替代方案
example: Cycling is a useful alternative to driving for short journeys.
example_translation: 短途出行时，骑自行车是一种实用的驾车替代方式。

example: Although the path was steep, we reached the top before noon.
example_translation: 虽然山路陡峭，我们仍在中午前到达了山顶。

example: The tickets cost thirty pounds altogether.
example_translation: 这些票总共花了三十英镑。
note: 本批为总计义，不混用 all together

example: Our neighbour always checks on the elderly residents during storms.
example_translation: 暴风雨期间，我们的邻居总会去探望老年住户。
note: 本例为经常重复的行为

example: An amateur photographer took the winning picture.
example_translation: 一位业余摄影师拍下了那张获奖照片。

example: The view from the old tower was amazing.
example_translation: 从古塔望出去的景色令人惊叹。
note: 描述事物，区别于人的 amazed

example: Her ambition is to design buildings that use less energy.
example_translation: 她的志向是设计耗能更少的建筑。

example: The ambitious student hopes to build a solar-powered boat.
example_translation: 那位有抱负的学生希望造一艘太阳能船。

example: An ambulance arrived within minutes of the call.
example_translation: 呼叫后几分钟内，一辆救护车赶到了。
